data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Coffee table arrived with damage- Third time](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5c156cf6917d9749a7d3ff)
Coffee table arrived with damage- this was table #3. This was 5 days ago. I and the delivery company notified customer service for LuLu and Georgia- I have still not heard back. There is no way to contact customer service other than email- it takes days to hear back. No one ever calls although a call is requested. At this point, I have asked for a refund and would like to have it expedited. Terrible customer service.

July 6, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 20, 2026

Hi there,

We sincerely apologize for the frustrating experience you've had with the damaged coffee table and the lack of communication. We understand your disappointment and are truly sorry for the inconvenience this has caused, especially with this being the third instance. We received your email and will be in touch shortly.
